canon_ref.note: A bedtime-story night in the Painted Soldiers' barracks (Belgrade, Anand, Garry, Pawn, Bird listen). Night day is a guess; the frames of Pt. 3 – 5 are one evening.

b6.klbkch_reads_the_war_history_to_the_h.summary: Klbkch reads a Drake's history of the Second Antinium War to the Free Antinium, with popcorn, and adds his own memory of the first battle. Erin joins them and then reads them a children's book. History notes only: the war was in 13 – 14 A.F. and the Goblin King Velan came to Izril.

canon_ref.note: Erin is away at the Hive; Mrsha, Lyonette, the Halfseekers and five Redfang listen. Pisces' claim about Dragon bones in the Walled Cities is his drama, not a stated fact.

b6.pisces_reads_the_war_history_in_the_i.summary: While Erin is away, Pisces reads the history book aloud in the common room. Ceria, Ksmvr, Yvlon, Mrsha, Lyonette and the Redfang five listen.

canon_ref.note: She declines Magnolia's hospitality. Thomast wrote to the author years ago. Bethal's mother and father died in the Sacrifice of Roses.

b6.bethal_stays_with_thomast_before_the_.summary: Lady Bethal reads the history of the Sacrifice of Roses in her husband's tent outside Invrisil, the night before the battle. Thomast tries to send her back from the fight.
